Evaluate the expression below.

\[3\cdot 10^{4}+9\cdot 10^{3}+1\cdot 10^{2}+8\cdot 10^{1}+4\cdot 10^{0}\]

This is easier than it looks.

\[3\cdot 10^{4}+9\cdot 10^{3}+1\cdot 10^{2}+8\cdot 10^{1}+4\cdot 10^{0}\]

\[3\cdot 10000+9\cdot 1000+1\cdot 100+8\cdot 10+4\cdot 1\]

\[30000+9000+100+80+4\]

Consider an alien society that uses base-8 number system with the following symbols:

Human number Alien numeral
0 0
1 A
2 B
3 C
4 D
5 E
6 F
7 G

Notice, the alien 0 is the same as our 0, but then they use uppercase letters in the order of our alphabet instead of Arabic numerals.

A human wants to convert the number 312 to Alien. Do this for them.

Divide 312 by the base 8 to get a quotient and remainder. \[\frac{312}{8}~=~39+\frac{0}{8}\]

(The quotient was 39 and the remainder was 0.)

Divide 39 by the base 8 to get a quotient and remainder. \[\frac{39}{8}~=~4+\frac{7}{8}\]

(The quotient was 4 and the remainder was 7.)

Divide 4 by the base 8 to get a quotient and remainder. \[\frac{4}{8}~=~0+\frac{4}{8}\]

(The quotient was 0 and the remainder was 4.)

Now, write down the remainders in reverse order.

\[\text{remainders}~=~4, 7, 0\]

And, lastly, use the table to convert those amounts into alien symbols.

The answer: DG0
